verdict.rationale: mParticle supports background automation in the form of continuously running audience computation, data transformation, and forwarding rules that execute without manual intervention once configured (e.g., composable audiences, real-time transforms, forwarding to downstream services). However, there is no evidence of AI-agent-driven or user-defined autonomous automation setup (e.g., natural-language triggered workflows that run independently); the AI-sounding audience description features are marketing claims without documented autonomous execution loop. Missing for 10: agentic/AI-driven automation creation, evidence of autonomous decision-making or scheduling beyond static rule-based forwarding, independent corroboration of these automations running unattended reliably.
